question.text: In the centralized demise reporting mechanism, if a transaction request is received on an account flagged as 'On Hold' due to an unavailable death certificate, what is the correct treatment?

answer.text: Allow the transaction only after additional due diligence (such as a video call or IPV) establishes that the investor is alive
All transactions including credits are rejected

explanation.text: The Logic: When an account is 'On Hold' because the death certificate is unavailable, a transaction request can be allowed only after additional due diligence — such as a video call or in-person verification (IPV) — establishes that the investor is alive. The Trap: Treating 'On Hold' as automatic debit blocking is incorrect at this stage. Debit blocking applies after death certificate verification or when the KRA status is Blocked Permanently. Note: 'On Hold' triggers an alive-status check via additional due diligence, not an automatic block on every transaction.
